name: sgs/notice-banner
title: SGS Notice Banner
description: Inline informational banner for contextual messages like minimum order values, delivery terms, or promotional notices.

banner.label: Banner
banner._note: NO-WRAPPER, content-KIND (D294, render.php:9-21) — dropped SGS_Container_Wrapper, block-private; every declaration scoped to the block's own `.{uid}` style (render.php:200-278). Layer CONTENT names the structural role (this block has no GRID layer).

icon.label: Icon
icon._note: iconColour/iconColourHover explicitly mapped (base + states.hover) since 2026-09-04 (D956) -- both used to resolve via the default {prefix}{suffix} convention, which routed them to the SAME (css:color, element=icon, state=NULL) slot with no way to tell them apart, a real routing-determinism ambiguity (F6 Check #1/#8). Emitted as scoped rules (`.{uid} .sgs-notice-banner__icon{color:...}` base, a touch-guarded :hover + unguarded :focus-visible pair for the Hover attr via sgs_hover_state_rules()), not inline -- gated on iconColour being set. `css:stroke` (D636/D644 icon/SVG gradient mechanism) explicit-mapped to iconColourGradient, added 2026-08-16 (Builder 4) — non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php). The badge (iconCircle*) mappings added 2026-09-26 mirror sgs/trust-bar's own icon-badge element (trust-bar/block.json::supports.sgs.elements.icon-badge) onto this SAME element rather than a second one -- notice-banner has one icon element throughout, the badge is a variant of it (`iconStyle:'circle'`), not a distinct node. Emitted via includes/notice-banner-icon-badge.php through the block's own `$scoped_css` array (Spec 32 no-inline contract) -- never trust-bar's inline custom-property `style` attribute.

arrows.label: Rotation arrows
arrows._note: U-15 — rotate mode's previous/next controls only (block.json::messageMode). Explicit attrMap (not the default {prefix}{suffix} convention) because the block has no `arrow` PREFIX declared. Emitted scoped on `.sgs-notice-banner__prev`/`.sgs-notice-banner__next` via sgs_hover_state_rules(), gated on arrowColour being set.

icon-glyph.label: Icon glyph size
icon-glyph._note: A second element sharing the `icon` prefix, scoped to ONLY iconSize -- the glyph size, distinct from iconCircleSize (the badge diameter, mapped on the sibling `icon` element above). Both elements declare `layout`'s css:width/css:height member with DIFFERENT target attrs; each resolves independently (check-element-manifest-conformance.js resolves attrMap per element, not per prefix), so both iconSize and iconCircleSize are claimed rather than orphaned. iconSize sizes the <svg> width/height for lucide/wp-icon, or the font-size for dashicon/emoji (includes/notice-banner-icon-badge.php) -- one glyph-size concept, two CSS mechanisms depending on icon source, same as the `icon` element's own css:stroke/css:color split.

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the icon's stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time (D636/D644).

iconColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of iconColourGradient. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover at render time.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.

iconSize.description: Icon glyph size in px (8 to 96). Applies in both iconStyle values (bare and circle).

iconStyle.description: Bare (default) shows just the glyph, today's look. Circle wraps it in a background badge (a circle or rounded square).

iconCircleSize.description: iconStyle:'circle' only. Badge diameter in px (24 to 96), independent of iconSize (the glyph inside it).

iconCircleBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the badge background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconCircleBackground at render time (D636/D644).

iconCircleBackgroundHover.description: Hover-state background colour for the icon badge.

iconCircleBackgroundHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of iconCircleBackgroundHover. Non-empty wins over iconCircleBackgroundHover at render time.

iconCircleBorderRadius.description: 50% makes a circle; a px value makes a rounded square.

iconCircleShadow.description: Unlike sgs/trust-bar's icon-circle badge (default 'whisper'), a notice banner's badge carries no shadow by default -- it already sits on a coloured strip.

iconCircleBorderWidth.description: 4-side box-object family (box_family 'iconCircleBorderWidth'). Empty (unset) falls through to style.css's framework-default fallback (1px) so an unmodified badge still reads as a circle; an explicit 0 on every side removes the border entirely.

iconCircleBorderStyle.description: Unset (default) falls through to style.css's framework-default fallback (solid).

iconCircleBorderColour.description: Unset (default) falls through to style.css's framework-default fallback (rgba(0,0,0,0.08)).

messageMode.description: U-15: static shows every sgs/notice-message child stacked (or the single child). rotate/random need at least two sgs/notice-message children to take effect — with fewer, the banner renders exactly as static.

rotateInterval.description: Seconds between automatic rotations (2 to 30). rotate mode only.

showMessageArrows.description: rotate mode only — previous/next controls that also pause auto-rotation.

pauseOnHover.description: rotate mode only — hover or focus within the banner pauses rotation.

attributes.text: A brief supporting statement that explains your value proposition.
